items.title: For 44 years, this investor held aces in the long-bond game. He just folded.
items.description: Lacy Hunt’s about-face on long-term Treasurys marks the end of an era. Here’s what it means for your money.

items.title: SpaceX’s stock falls to a new low despite a near-flawless Starship flight
items.description: SpaceX’s earnings report next week could unleash a further wave of selling, as some insiders will soon be able to unload shares.

items.title: Micron and other chip stocks fall as China steals the spotlight
items.description: CXMT had a strong public debut in Shanghai, and now investors are weighing the prospect of a manufacturing breakthrough that could make China’s chip industry more competitive.

items.title: ‘I’m still confused’: I sold $80,000 in shares on June 30, so why didn’t I receive my dividend?
items.description: “To my surprise, the proceeds from the sale were credited to my money-market settlement fund.”

items.title: Apple reclaims title of world’s largest company after historic stretch of outperformance
items.description: Apple’s stock is on track to see its best monthly performance in more than two decades relative to the Nasdaq-100.

items.title: ‘I know what he wants to do,’ Trump says of Fed’s Warsh, as president presses for rate cuts
items.description: New Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh “wants to do the right thing” but is facing a Fed board that might oppose him, the president said.

items.title: ‘We are not romantically involved’: I’m marrying my platonic best friend of 20 years. Should I leave him my home?
items.description: “I own my home outright, have no children or other dependents.”

items.title: I am a 63-year-old semiretired physician. If I saved $2 million for retirement, should my Social Security become optional?
items.description: “At that point, they arguably no longer need the government’s retirement safety net.”

items.title: Should you get paid to care for a family member?
items.description: Serving as a family caregiver isn’t just exhausting. It can be financially devastating, as well.

items.title: ‘It’s a high price to pay’: My adviser says I don’t need a withdrawal plan for my $2.3 million portfolio. Is he right?
items.description: “His proposal involves a proprietary equity hedge strategy to manage $700,000 of my assets.”
